name: Bloodcraft weakens enemies hit by Darkfallen Lament (#2213)
contract: Bloodcraft 680733 reads 'Your damage dealt by Darkfallen Lament now applies Bloodcraft to affected enemies, reducing damage dealt by $524182s1% for $524182d, stacking $524182u times'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Bloodcraft 524182 (MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, MiscValue 127 = all schools, BasePoints -3 -> -2%, StackAmount 4, TargetA 6). Spell.dbc gives 680733 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and no enemy was ever debuffed. Darkfallen Lament is cast as 524181, a direct SPELL_EFFECT_HEALTH_LEECH record carrying SpellFamilyFlags (0, 0, 4096) - the mask the new row uses - with no cooldown and no Cursed Form gate. A diagnostic assertion confirms the cast actually damaged the target before the debuff is checked.
